opportunities.title: Research Project Grants (Detailed Applications)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers based at UK universities or institutions of higher education, and on a trial basis UK-based independent research institutes/organisations. PI must be employed by eligible institution.
opportunities.summary: For researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education, to undertake an innovative and original research project. Two-stage process; outline stage paused, detailed applications open until 1 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas. Applications made by a member of academic staff at a UK university with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance skills and knowledge in an underrepresented area of research.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers, resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research. Application materials will be available in September 2026.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Trust contributes 100% of salary up to £56,000 in year one, 50% up to £28,000 in years two and three, plus up to £6,000 per annum research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post, must hold a doctorate by take-up.
opportunities.summary: For early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work. Link to apply will open in due course; closing date 18 February 2027.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post, living in the UK for at least 26 weeks a year.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired to complete a research project and prepare results for publication. Application materials available in September 2026.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered by the Office for Students holding their own research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. Expected to open February 2027 for outline applications in June 2027.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards (Centenary)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Talented early career scholars embarking on a university career, holding a permanent academic appointment at lecturer level or equivalent.
opportunities.summary: For talented scholars embarking on a university career to build a research team to tackle a distinctive research problem. Centenary round opens January 2028 for submission in May 2028.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Replacement salary costs for the duration of the Fellowship

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well-established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences employed at an eligible UK university.
opportunities.summary: For well-established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences to complete a piece of original research. Closing date falls in May each year.
